new_categories.label: dry_cargo_hold_fire_protection_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo-hold fire detection and fixed-suppression assurance is a delivered protective service-state that can be represented separately from cargo-dust control, ventilation and ordinary hold operations.

new_categories.label: hold_fire_detector_readiness
new_categories.memory: Detector readiness in a bounded dry-cargo-hold scope can be represented independently from indication availability, coverage confidence and suppression readiness.

new_categories.label: hold_detection_coverage_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that detection coverage addresses the intended hold or bounded cargo-space scope is distinct from individual detector readiness without retaining exact detector type or location.

new_categories.label: fire_indication_path_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-exact indication/alarm-path confidence state can be represented separately from detector condition without retaining thresholds, signal logic or panel details.

new_categories.label: fire_detection_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Detection validity is distinct from simple detector or indication availability and can degrade without retaining calibration, test values or alarm thresholds.

new_categories.label: fixed_suppression_agent_support_readiness
new_categories.memory: Readiness of the fixed-suppression agent/support layer can be represented separately from detection and release-readiness states without retaining agent type, capacity or pressure.

new_categories.label: suppression_distribution_path_readiness
new_categories.memory: The abstract availability of a suppression distribution/delivery path to the intended hold can be represented without retaining piping layout, nozzle arrangement or capacity.

new_categories.label: suppression_release_readiness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Release readiness can be represented as a protective assurance state distinct from agent availability and distribution-path readiness without retaining release sequence or operating procedure.

new_categories.label: fire_protection_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, control or other support dependency confidence can be represented separately from the delivered fire-protection service without retaining exact topology or interlocks.

new_categories.label: fire_protection_monitoring_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring and verification confidence is distinct from physical detector/suppression readiness and can degrade independently without retaining test procedures.

new_categories.label: dry_hold_fire_protection_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The dry-hold protective service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_fire_protection_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to detector, coverage, indication, suppression support, release-readiness or hold scope, while cargo-work restriction, safety concern, terminal confidence, rework or delay do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_fire_protection_restoration
new_categories.memory: Detector recovery, indication recovery, suppression-support restoration, release-readiness verification, hold-scope release and operational confidence can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: dry_hold_fire_protection_vs_liquid_cargo_area_fire_protection
useful_refinements.memory: A dry-cargo-hold protective scope should remain distinct from liquid-cargo-area fire detection/suppression because operating environment and cargo-space boundary are different even when abstract protective-state mechanics overlap.

useful_refinements.label: fire_suppression_vs_cargo_dust_control
useful_refinements.memory: P121 dust suppression/collection support is an operational dust-control service and should not be treated as equivalent to fixed fire suppression readiness.

useful_refinements.label: fire_protection_vs_hold_ventilation
useful_refinements.memory: Hold ventilation or atmosphere-management readiness does not establish fire detection or fixed-suppression assurance even when both depend on bounded hold scope and support systems.

useful_refinements.label: release_readiness_vs_emergency_response_procedure
useful_refinements.memory: A structural release-readiness state can be retained without retaining or implying a specific firefighting, evacuation or suppression-release procedure.

duplicates.label: generic_detection_coverage_indication_validity_support_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic detection, coverage, indication, validity and support-confidence mechanics repeat earlier protective-assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.
